answer: To speak in markets an agent commissions a certified pigment assay for 18 units and must have three independent labs titrate the same sealed saffron sample. Each lab posts an optical-density curve hash on-ledger. If any curve is missing or mismatched the application is left hollow and the fee is forfeited. Verifiers re-hash the published curves and check that the sample serial appears only once. When two agents share a serial, both fees are slashed and both names are barred for thirty epochs, so a clone swarm pays for a fresh assayed sample on every fake identity.
